verdict.rationale: HeyGen's own avatar system keeps a character consistent across shots and videos. It documents a digital twin 'with consistent identity' (heygen-docs-19), 'wide shots, medium frames, and close-ups, all consistent, all from one recording' (heygen-docs-40), and multi-shot cinematic avatar prompts (heygen-docs-18), and the same faces can be re-recorded through the API later (heygen-docs-31). Scene-level consistency rests only on Video Agent revisions keeping untouched scenes' visuals (heygen-docs-11). Missing for 10: documented scene/environment consistency across separately generated shots (e.g. for heygen-video-1 prompt clips), and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-shot consistency.
